title: Linear Functions: Slope, Forms of a Line and Scatter Plots | Algebra I, Unit 5 (with Worked Examples)
description:
Find slope from a graph and from two points, write and graph lines in slope-intercept, point-slope and standard form, compare parallel and perpendicular lines, transform linear graphs, and fit a line to a scatter plot. After every lesson there's a step-by-step worked example with tips and a practice question, and the unit ends with a real-world "Putting it together" problem.
